Get BNXT League Schedule

Source: R/sportpress.R
sportpress_schedule.Rd

Every game of a season for Belgian and Dutch clubs, with teams, scores, phase and venue.

Endpoint: GET https://bnxt.sportpress.info/api/v1/schedule/club/{season}

Usage

sportpress_schedule(season, month = -1, phase_id = NULL)

Arguments

season

(required) Season END year (2026 = 2025-26), the API's own key; no mapping is applied.

month

(default -1) Calendar month filter; -1 (default) = the whole season in one body.

phase_id

(default NULL) Restrict to one phase (integer), from sportpress_phases(). Omitted = every phase.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per game. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "sportpress_schedule")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportpress_ui_strings().

See also

family_bnxt_league lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(sportpress_schedule(season = 2026))
